subject: Slider with more than 2 input values?

messages.author: 739fdf482da22353
messages.subject: Slider with more than 2 input values?
parts:
Dear all,

I know that there is a slider widget with a single input value and one for two input values (slider range). 

Is there also a slider widget with several input values? If not would it be very hard to program that?

I need this 'new' type of slider so that users can input a vector of cumulative probabilities that define a marginal distribution.

Thank you!

Paul

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Re: Slider with more than 2 input values?
parts: Shiny uses another JavaScript software for creating sliders. You should make a feature request to the rangeSlider project. If the developer accepts your request, it will become available through Shiny after Shiny is updated by its maintainer to use the new version of rangeSlider. You have an interesting use case, so the developer would be likely to agree to implement it himself.
